title: MagScan
summary: Metal detector for CardputerZero C154/C154-B (needs the BMM150 magnetometer)
description:
MagScan turns the CardputerZero's BMM150 magnetometer into a metal detector. It tracks deviations of the local magnetic field, shows live field strength and warns about AC interference.

Hardware: works only on the CardputerZero Kickstarter edition (SKU C154 / C154-B), the only model with the BMM150 magnetometer. CardputerZero-Lite (C155 / C155-B) and CardputerZero v1.0 (C154-V1) have no magnetometer: on those the app only shows a "sensor not found" screen.
